method: Read-only classification of every template.yaml under scripts/golden-paths against ADR-008-001 applicability selectors (Azure, Terraform, one supported archetype, one dev/qas/prd environment) and the five Contract A archetypes in FR-ARCH-002 through FR-ARCH-006. No template.yaml, skeleton, or Terraform file was changed to produce this inventory.
path_deviation_note: TASKS.md T002 names golden-paths/common/generated-terraform/template-inventory.json. This repository's canonical Backstage template tree is scripts/golden-paths/ (see ADR-008-016's own finding of a canonical/mirror split, which does not match current repository reality: no root-level golden-paths/ directory exists). This file is committed at scripts/golden-paths/common/generated-terraform/template-inventory.json to avoid creating a second, conflicting top-level golden-paths/ tree without an architecture decision. Reconciling ADR-008-016 with actual repository layout is an open item for open-horizons-architect, not resolved by this inventory.

templates.reason: Starts a governed AEG control-plane run instead of publishing a repository. The scaffolder writes no files, so this template selects no archetype and emits no Azure infrastructure of its own; the infrastructure of whatever the AEG implements is classified against the template that generates it.

templates.name: h1-infrastructure-provisioning
templates.reason: Pre-existing generic Azure Terraform/Bicep provisioning template with the closest scope overlap to this feature. It predates the five-archetype contract and is not archetype-scoped. Wiring feature 008 here requires an ADR reconciling ADR-008-016 template ownership with this existing template before T025 can update it, plus every CK-INPUT-001 through CK-INPUT-009 external input.

templates.name: h1-new-microservice

templates.name: h1-web-application

FR-ARCH-001 requires exactly one archetype per generated manifest, so this template needs a decision on which deployment target this feature wires first, plus CK-INPUT-001 through CK-INPUT-009.
